glosses: to add by pouring, to top up, to top off (someone's drink)

examples.text: […] dolewał mu wciąż do kieliszka doskonałej wiśniówki […]

glosses: To fill or refill (a drink etc.) so that the container is completely full.

examples.text: The waitress topped off my coffee every few minutes.

glosses: To complete, to put the finishing touch to (something).

examples.text: The banquet was topped off with coffee and chocolate.
Dolewał mu wciąż do kieliszka doskonałej wiśniówki.
